paragraph: Do not ever be afraid of death. There is no fixed hour appointed that fear can calculate or bargain with, and so fear itself is out of place. If somebody has gone to heaven, that should not produce dread in us. It should be our joy.

There is no fixed hour appointed.note: Paraphrase of 'there is no set time'.

and so fear itself is out of place.note: Consequence of the prohibition and of fear being not normal. Not a new causal mechanism.
